title: PA eval case (v1) — formalizes the organic MTU/TGG/Guava case shapes
description: One behavioral expectation-carrying case for a PA client agent. Lineage: MTU cases.json (prompt + expected[]), Guava phase-b-judge.schema.json (verdict/rubric/outcome_class), Christopher eval-port (pins + replay path). A case is authored once and run many times; run-time pins live in the run manifest, not here.

client.description: Client agent tenant id (mtu, tgg, guava).

source.description: Where this case came from. Correction-derived cases are the highest-value class: every principal/client correction of live behavior MUST yield one.

correction.description: The ruling this case encodes. Required when type=correction.

quote.description: Verbatim or tight paraphrase of the correction; paraphrase must be marked.

ruling_ref.description: Pointer to the durable ruling record (constitution line, memory entry, decision record).

tags.description: Behavior-area tags used for gate selection (e.g. intake, rop, ilp, shield, sustainability, escalation, never-ask, formatting, new-case-boundary, product-shorthand). A knowledge/constitution edit re-runs the tags it touches; a model swap runs everything.

turns.description: Ordered user-side stimulus turns. Multi-turn is first-class: ask-once and new-case-boundary defects only reproduce across turns. A turn may declare expected_before_next to assert on the intermediate reply.

expected_before_next.description: Labels that must hold on the reply to THIS turn (e.g. 'asks only for premium').

expected.description: Expected-behavior labels judged on the final response (and per-turn via expected_before_next). Each is judgeable in isolation.

label.description: Short judgeable statement, e.g. 'derives ROP from existing-plans answer without asking'.

kind.description: must/must_not are judge-scored; exact_present/exact_absent are deterministic string checks scored by the runner, not the judge (compliance sentences, disclosures, markdown markers). no_approved_block is the deterministic NO-DRAFT check: it passes when the response carries none of the deployment's approved compliance block texts, which a completed draft always splices verbatim. Use it wherever the ruled behaviour is to withhold a draft, because a judge-kind must_not scores nothing when the judge has not run.

text.description: For exact_* kinds: the literal string. Whitespace-normalized comparison.

critical.description: A critical miss fails the case regardless of everything else (compliance inversion, fabricated product fact, client-visible internals).

draws.description: Number of independent runs required. Probabilistic behaviors (compliance-sentence direction, drafts-anyway-on-underspecified) require draws >= 4; one draw is a sample, not a property (MTU 2026-07-23 lesson).

canary.description: Fabrication canary: a case where the tempting wrong behavior is confident invention (Guava pattern). Canary failures are reported separately and never averaged away.

provenance.description: Audit chain for the expectation itself: which approved source makes this the CORRECT behavior.

standard_ref.description: The knowledge artifact or ruling that defines correctness (e.g. knowledge/standard-disclosures.md, amelia ruling 2026-07-31).

unverified.description: True when the underlying approval is untraceable — the case still runs, but its standard is flagged (MTU replacement-disadvantages lesson).
